independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the gap between choices (vertical and horizontal) and the row pitch.

intent: Choose exactly one option from a small mutually exclusive set, with one value for the set
Group radios under one name, value and validity

properties.description: Form field name; the group submits the checked radio's value under it (the radios inside need no name).
Disables every radio inside (they read the group's isDisabled) and submits nothing. An ancestor <fieldset disabled> or ui-fieldset[disabled] has the same effect.
A radio must be checked to submit (valueMissing on the group).
The checked radio's value ('' when none). Setting it checks the radio with that value and unchecks the rest, without an event.
Base UI defaultValue: the value at first render (when no value attribute set it) and after form reset. Without it, the value attribute, else a radio authored checked, is the default.
The radios can be focused but not changed (aria-readonly, data-readonly).
vertical: one radio per row, 1u apart. horizontal: a wrapping row, 4u between radios (aria-orientation).
Accessible name (aria-label) when no visible label names the group: prefer a ui-field label or a ui-fieldset legend.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: Gap between radios in u (0…8 in 0.5 steps), along the group's direction; default 1u vertical, 4u horizontal.

events.name: input
events.detail: { value: string, reason: 'none', event: Event } (Base UI onValueChange)
events.trigger: the user checks a different radio (press, Space or an arrow key)

events.name: change
events.trigger: the user checks a different radio (same moment as input)

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses the tab-stop radio: the checked one, else the first enabled one.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Runs validation; fires invalid when it fails.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Marks the group touched (errors show) and reports.

methods.name: setCustomValidity
methods.description: Sets an author error; an empty string clears it.

semantics.formValue: value (the checked radio's value), nothing when empty

keyboard.action: into the group: the checked radio (or the first enabled one); out of it: the next control
move to and check the next / previous enabled radio of this group (wraps)

content.children: ui-radio children (each with a value); they may sit in wrappers. Other content is laid out with them.

constraints: The group owns the value: it sets its radios' checked state from value; a radio press, Space or arrow key changes the group value, and the group (not the radio) fires input and change.

Its radios are the ui-radio descendants whose nearest ui-radio-group is this one; they group by membership, not name, so two groups never share arrows or tab stops. Give the group the name; the radios submit nothing.
disabled and readonly reach every radio (a radio's isDisabled reads the group); disabled also submits nothing. The radios keep their own disabled.
required: the group is invalid (valueMissing) until a radio is checked; the error shows after the group is left or a submit is blocked.
Contains no native form elements; form participation goes through ElementInternals (UIFormElement).

React: RadioGroup (a single part, as in Base UI) renders a div role=radiogroup; its Radio children are native radios that take the group's name (generated when omitted), checked state, disabled and required from context; onValueChange(value, { reason: 'none', event }); render and className (a string or (state) => string) apply to it.

avoidWhen.reason: A radio group holds one value.
A long radio list is hard to scan; a select collapses it.

avoidWhen.when: Switching views or modes in place.
avoidWhen.reason: A segmented control is the compact single choice for views.

props: render?: RenderProp // Replace the part's element (Base UI render): an element (the part's props merge into it) or `(props, state) => element`. The recipe class and data-* stay on whatever renders.
className?: string | ((state: PartState) => string | undefined) // Author class, or a function of the part's state (Base UI className); added after the recipe class.
name?: string // Form name of the radios; generated when omitted (they still group).
value?: string // The checked radio's value (controlled).
defaultValue?: string // The first value when uncontrolled, and the reset value.
onValueChange?: (value: string, details: ChangeDetails) => void // The user picked a radio (Base UI onValueChange; reason 'none').
readOnly?: boolean = false // Radios can be focused but not changed.
required?: boolean = false // One radio must be checked to submit.
orientation?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' = 'vertical' // vertical: one radio per row; horizontal: a wrapping row.
label?: string // Accessible name when no Field label or Fieldset legend names the group (aria-label).
size?: number // Unit u in px for the group and its radios.
